description: This file defines the AddFileActivity class, an Android activity responsible for creating data files based on user input or intent parameters. It manages file creation in internal, external, or no-backup storage, with UI elements for filename, file size, and storage options, including validation and feedback mechanisms.

classes.name: AddFileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity facilitating creation of data files with specified name, size, and storage location, with UI controls and intent handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI and spinners for file size and storage options.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks for intent extras to pre-create files if parameters are provided.

methods.name: onCreateFileButtonClick
methods.description: Handles user interaction to create a new file based on input fields.

methods.name: initFileSizeSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting file size multiplier options.

methods.name: initFileStorageSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting file storage location.

methods.name: createFileWithRandomDataAndFinishActivity
methods.description: Creates a file with random data of specified size in the selected storage, then finishes activity with success or error result.

methods.name: isFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file with the given name already exists in internal storage.

methods.name: isSizeValid
methods.description: Validates that the size parameter is a non-negative number.

methods.name: isFileStorageParamValid
methods.description: Validates and processes the file storage parameter.

methods.name: getInternalFile
methods.description: Returns a File object representing an internal storage file with the given filename.
